# Repair Text Encoding resets headers before reloading the message

MailSetCharacterSet calls ClearCurrentHeaders before reloading the current message. That reset clears header and attachment state; the existing header sink otherwise appends repeated To/Cc data. The added regression assertion waits for repair reload and checks one To child. It does not count attachments or prove every header category or runtime repair path. The older attachment-node reset contract remains a separate reused lesson.

Scope: Message charset-repair lifecycle.
